content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with [product_name] Web Editor. When I log into the web server, I am unable to access the page I created with [product_name] Web Editor and receive a '404: The target is not found' error. Does anyone know how to resolve this?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Could you please upload your [product_name] Web Editor project as a ZIP file?
Of course, thank you for your assistance. I need to split this file into two parts; please refer to my next post and combine them upon extraction.
Rename this file to havasaz.z01 and extract it together with the other part.

Your [product_name] Web Editor project doesn't seem to be the issue. I was able to transfer it to my [product_name] device and view the extended web server in my browser. Which specific [product_name] device do you have? Please provide the complete [article_no]. Also, do you have an SD card inserted in your [product_name]?
Yes, I have a 4GB SD card formatted with FAT32. Can I access my customized site using only a local network, without an internet connection?

Hi, yes, you can use the web server within a local network. Check the following: - Ensure the SD card works properly on the [product_name] device by copying the program from the device to the card. - Verify that your browser supports http connections; some modern browsers require https by default. If this is the case, you may need to add an exception in your browser's security settings. - Make sure the IP address of your [product_name] device is outside the DHCP range assigned by your router. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties accessing custom pages created with [product_name] Web Editor on the device's web server, resulting in a '404: The target is not found' error. The issue is likely related to device settings, server configuration, or browser compatibility rather than the editor project itself. There is some confusion about whether web server access depends on active internet connection, suggesting a need for clearer guidance regarding system setup and networking requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that a custom web page created with [product_name] Web Editor and stored on the device should be accessible from a browser over the local network, independent of internet connectivity.
